instruction: Adjust Chrome so it launches with a new tab on startup instead of reopening previous tabs.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to change Chrome's startup behavior to open a new tab (fresh start mode) instead of restoring previous session. The evaluator uses the existing get_new_startup_page getter function. Task complexity is similar to the original - navigating to Chrome settings and modifying a single configuration option. Verified by reading the getter implementation at lines 1363-1398 in chrome.py, which checks if session.restore_on_startup equals 5 (new tab mode) or if session key doesn't exist (fresh start).
metadata.verification_method: Uses existing Chrome getter function get_new_startup_page which reads from Preferences file

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly identifies Chrome startup mode: checks both cases where session key doesn't exist (fresh start) and where session.restore_on_startup equals 5 (new tab mode)
